newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary FX futures traders spurn trendless mkt.
newsitem.headline: Hungary FX futures traders spurn trendless mkt.

text.p: Total Hungarian currency futures trade fell back on Friday as speculators on the Budapest Commodities Exchange looked ahead to yen and dollar developments and most Stock Exchange traders stayed on the sidelines.
The Budapest Commodities Exchange (BCE) recorded a low 1.9 billion forints turnover while the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) registered only 88.5 million forints.
The yen dominated BCE trade, accounting for 9,730 lots out of a total 12,190, moslty in longer term contracts for September and December @
"There is still a feeling that in the longer term the dollar will strengthen and the yen may weaken," said Janos Mladenszki of Futures Broker Kft
The September yen rose 81 fillers to 161.20 forints per 100 yen while December yen rose 1.60 forints to 167.40.
The dollar rose 15 fillers for September to 189.15 and was stable for December at 194.20 forints.
The mark fell by 16 fillers for both months, ending at 113.00 for September and 116.75 for December. @
BSE turnover was made up entirely of one deal for March 1997 dollars.
"It had little significance -- I think it was just an agency cross," said Andras Peto of MKB Ertekpapir Rt
The deal moved the March dollar just four fillers weaker to 176.9 forints. No other price movements were registered. -- Duncan Shiels, Budapest newsroom (361) 327 4040
